observability_triage.rationale: Cross-user equality of bullet size and spacing is a rendered-output property across machines. The current repository can parse OOXML declarations but cannot render the same frozen fixture under multiple pinned Word installations, font sets, printer metrics, and display settings.
repair_requirements: Freeze a representative bullet-list DOCX fixture and exact comparison regions.
Provide at least two pinned Word-for-Windows environments with identical embedded/installed font packages and printer metrics.
Define numeric tolerances for bullet glyph bounds, baseline, indentation, and paragraph spacing.

evidence: The target asks about what other users see, not only serialized OOXML values.
The pre-repo has no Word renderer or multi-environment comparison harness.
Font substitution and printer/layout metrics are not frozen by the current behavior contract.
missing_observables: Rendered bullet glyph bounds and baselines on each supported Word environment
Rendered paragraph spacing on each supported Word environment
minimum_environment_repairs: Add a network-disabled render matrix with pinned Word builds, fonts, locale, and printer driver.
Add deterministic geometry extraction and tolerance-based comparison for the frozen bullet fixture.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author criteria when a frozen multi-environment Word render matrix produces comparable bullet geometry and spacing measurements.

uncovered_items.evidence: The current artifact parser cannot observe cross-user rendered equality.
uncovered_items.required_action: Freeze and expose a multi-environment Word render comparison before validator authoring.
